business_summary.text: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Limited is a financial technology company focused on making insurance accessible and trusted for Indian households through a technology platform and a network of digital partners.

call_points.text: Management expects 40% YoY revenue growth and adjusted EBITDA breakeven in FY27.
Service EBITDA margin guidance of 16-18% in the near term, with a long-term target of 23-24%.
ESOP cost for the quarter was ₹7 Cr, with no significant costs between adjusted EBITDA and PAT.
Management is monitoring the impact of Supreme Court judgment on Motor TP pricing and potential commission regulation changes.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence has levied the penalty against the Company under section 122 (1) of the CGST Act,2017 f of Rs. 511.96 millions (as disclosed in financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2025). The Company has filed an appeal agianst the said penalty orders
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed the appeal, regularly attended hearings, and responded to the queries raised by the appellate authority

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Income Tax Department passed assessment orders under Sections 143(3) and 147 for FY 2017-18, 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22 and 2022-23, making ad hoc disallowances under Section 37 aggregating to INR 62.25 million. (as disclosed in financial statement for the year ended March 31, 2025) . The disalowances were set off against brought-forward tax losses resulting in a nil tax demand. Penalty proceedings under Sections 270A and 271AAD have been initiated but are currently kept in abeyance, pending disposal of the Company’s appeals.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Assistant Commissioner of income tax, Central circle, Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed the appeal and responded to the queries raised by the appellate authority

guidance.statement: Service EBITDA margin to reach 16-18% in the near term
